description: This PHP class 'InterviewDecorator' provides an object-oriented wrapper to manage 'Interview' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It simplifies interactions such as setting candidate and vacancy references, managing interviewers, and formatting interview date/time details.

classes.name: InterviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps around the 'Interview' entity, providing convenient methods to set related entities, manage interviewers, and retrieve formatted date/time information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an 'Interview' entity instance.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a 'CandidateVacancy' to the interview by its ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a 'Candidate' to the interview by its ID.

methods.name: setInterviewerByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple 'Employee' interviewers to the interview based on their employee numbers.

methods.name: addInterviewer
methods.description: A private helper method to add an 'Employee' interviewer to the interview if not already added.

methods.name: removeInterviewers
methods.description: Removes all interviewers from the interview entity.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted interview date as a string.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted interview time as a string, or null if not set.
